r.경제 체제: Mineral exports · copper, coal, dependence on China
r.생활 물가 수준: 33% of the US level (2025, World Bank, household consumption at purchasing power parity against the market exchange rate)
r.주요 수출품: Coal 61%, Copper ore 24%, Gold 5%, Wool 3%, Salt, stone, minerals 2% (2023, share of all exports, top 5)
r.한국이 파는 것: Aircraft 14%, Cars 7%, Cosmetics 7%, Beverages 6% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Ores 42%, Sweaters 9%, Animal and vegetable oils 8%, Precision and medical instruments 7% (2025, share of value)
r.정치 구도: Democracy protests in 1990 peacefully ended one-party communist rule and brought multiparty democracy. Voters elect the president directly, but parliament and the prime minister run the government, and coalitions and prime ministers change often.

t.why: Squeezed between Russia and China, it must keep a balance with both powers. It is rich in minerals such as copper and coal.
t.rel: A landlocked country squeezed between Russia and China. It balances the two powers while widening ties with 'third neighbors' such as the United States, Japan and South Korea.
t.korea: Many Mongolians work in Korea, and Korean culture is very popular. Korean companies have taken part in mining and construction projects.
t.know: Livestock far outnumber people: sheep, goats, horses and cattle together are more than ten times the human population.
t.etext: It mines copper, coal and gold and sells most of it to China. The Oyu Tolgoi copper mine has a huge influence on the economy.
